definitions.candidate_self: model feedback gates repair; gold is for scoring only
definitions.candidate_executor: strict executor feedback, modified by the selected text ablation
definitions.generation: unique grid/start/goal; initial G and planning sessions shared across splits
definitions.cost: per-method cost excludes shared initial G; controller requests include cached G and rule requests
definitions.success_rate: goal reached without any error / all cases
definitions.repair_success_rate: success rate over originally invalid supplied candidates
definitions.feasibility: all actions legal and in bounds without obstacles; goal not required
definitions.rule_search_rows: symbolically scored prefixes, excluded from neural decoder_row_steps

physical_cost.definition: Cumulative actual requests for completed splits; paired environment sessions counted once. Model loading and host idle time are in the GPU ledger, not task active_seconds. Interrupted incomplete splits retain charged attempts in their session journals.
